case_name: Anil Kumar & Ors v. The State (NCT Of Delhi) & Anr

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Anil Kumar & Ors — husband, wife, and others
parties.respondent_defendant: The State (NCT Of Delhi) & Anr — government, wife

facts_of_case: Marriage between the petitioner no.1 and respondent No.2 was solemnized on 30.01.2005. Due to matrimonial difference, both parties started living separately since 08.02.2013. FIR No.421/2015 under Section 498A/406/34 IPC registered against him and the proceedings emanating therefrom.

legal_principles.principle: Parties can settle disputes through mediation and such settlements are enforceable.
legal_principles.held: In lieu of such settlement, now petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 are residing together in the matrimonial house.

legal_principles.principle: A settlement agreement can supersede pending legal proceedings.
legal_principles.held: In lieu of such settlement, now petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 are residing together in the matrimonial house.

outcome.final_order: FIR No.421/2015 under Section 498A/406/34 IPC is quashed, and the proceedings emanating therefrom are also quashed.

use_for_drafting: quashing FIR in domestic violence cases
